publishedInput.method: The user's Chrome through the official Claude in Chrome extension; Start was a real click, keys were synthetic in-page keydown/keyup events, and only the status line and canvas pixels were read.
observed: Rail Switch: Start opened timetable 1 of 20; Space flipped junction A and the prompt changed from 'Press Space: flip A to ↓ for the blue train' to 'Junctions are set - watch the blue train'. Repeated test presses toggled the junction back and produced strikes with the cause shown ('Strike! A train reached the wrong platform').
Tilt Lab: Start opened lab 1 of 22; holding Right for 0.9 s set the tilt readout to +8.2 and the marble rolled right.

notes: Assets were fetched with a cache-busting query string and compared with the committed files. The Snowball Siege rebuild remains unreleased.
